explication: This repository combines an iOS network-location spoofing module with an optional location-picker service. The main user workflow is to configure a target location, have a supported proxy intercept Apple’s WLOC response, and rewrite Wi-Fi and cell coordinates before iOS receives it. The picker offers Node and Cloudflare backends, plus token-based coordinate selection and administration. Edges reflect README statements and source-index references; some picker routes and platform wiring are documented but their full implementations were not sampled.
